review.notes: Reviewed the complete 2,185-line OCR Markdown sequentially and extracted text from all 144 physical PDF pages, checking paragraph/caption continuations and structural anomalies. Rendered selected pages for visual confirmation, including p.35 (Table 4.2.B) and p.71 (single composite chart); this was targeted visual review, not high-resolution visual review of every page. All page numbers are physical 1-based PDF pages. Also individually matched all 86 escaped-hyphen list items to the corresponding PDF page text; all are bullets.
